title: Kreativ Broken Image Finder in Active Maintenance
description: A short update on what Kreativ Broken Image Finder is built for and how it supports recurring media-quality reviews.
metaDescription: A short update on Kreativ Broken Image Finder, its use case, and how it supports recurring media-quality reviews.
intro: Kreativ Broken Image Finder is live and focused on helping content teams catch missing media references before those issues become visible to readers.

items.title: Built for media-quality maintenance
items.body: The plugin is intended for sites where broken images weaken the perceived quality of published content and create avoidable cleanup work later.

items.title: Best fit
items.body: It is especially useful for content-heavy WordPress sites that need a repeatable way to review image integrity across posts and pages.

items.title: What to expect
items.body: The main value is operational: run checks, identify the affected content quickly, and fix broken media references before readers hit them.
